findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uain_contributions, uain_member_request, uain_contribution · Private data: uain_native_state, uain_member_request, uain_feedback · Public sink: uain_guide, uain_member_request, uain_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uain_contributions, uain_member_request, uain_contribution · Private data: uain_native_state, uain_member_request, uain_feedback · Public sink: uain_guide, uain_member_request, uain_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
